data.one_liner: Configure menus or tab screens on each side of a Flutter layout.
data.what_it_does: PlutoLayout is a Flutter UI package that allows developers to configure a menu or tab screen on each side (top, bottom, left, right). It supports adjusting tab widths by dragging borders, as well as assigning custom keyboard shortcuts for opening, closing, and resizing tab views.
use_when: You are building an admin page or CMS with multiple side menus and tab views.
You need resizable side panels and dockable tab screens with keyboard shortcut support.
avoid_when: You only need simple responsive breakpoints or standard layout primitives like Row and Column.
You are looking for a complete navigation/routing solution.
strengths: Supports configurable tabs on all four sides (top, bottom, left, right).
Allows resizing tab views by dragging borders and supports custom shortcut keys.
weaknesses: Limited to specific admin-style multi-pane layout use cases.
Not documented for custom advanced layout constraints beyond the provided widgets.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need scalable and adaptive layouts based on responsive screen breakpoints.
